prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1376; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is entitled to compensation under the applicable policy.

Please direct all future communications regarding this matter, including any requests for statements, recorded or otherwise, to this office and not to our client. Kindly confirm in writing the policy number, the named insured, and the bodily injury liability limits available under the policy covering the at-fault driver.

We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair and total loss records, claim file materials, witness statements, and any dash camera or surveillance footage. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to this office.
